integrity: Symbolic proof plus locally executable exact integer verifier; bounded test runs do not establish universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The result is a negative answer to the invariant-curve-only part of Question 6.6 for an infinite subfamily, not a classification of all parameters. The general tensor-generation criterion, fan, and example of a non-invariant obstruction for other toric bundles are previous work. Potential earlier implicit fan calculation is a priority risk; the older Fujino–Sato full text was not inspected. No general autoequivalence result is established.
title: An invariant-surface obstruction without invariant-curve obstructions in non-projective toric threefolds
